segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר ״תְּנוּ גֵּט זֶה לְאִשְׁתִּי, שְׁטַר שִׁחְרוּר זֶה לְעַבְדִּי״, וּמֵת – לֹא יִתְּנוּ לְאַחַר מִיתָה. ״תְּנוּ מָנֶה לְאִישׁ פְּלוֹנִי״, וּמֵת – יִתְּנוּ לְאַחַר מִיתָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who says: Give this bill of divorce to my wife,» or: Give «this bill of manumission to my slave, and» then he «dies, one does not give it after» his «death.» The reason for this is that bills of divorce and manumission must be transferred by the husband or the master. Once he has died the document can no longer be given, and the agency he appointed for this purpose is likewise canceled. However, if he said: «Give one hundred dinars to so-and-so, and» then he «died, one does give» the recipient the money «after» his «death.»

moves.summary: Divorce and manumission documents are not given after death; a gift of a maneh is.

positions.claim: a bill of divorce or manumission is not given after the sender's death; a money gift is
